senses.gloss:
n. (-मं)
A sort of salt; see the next.
E.
रुम the place where it is found, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A kind of salt, according to some authorities, brought from a mountain in Ajmere, but in fact procured from a salt lake near the town of Sāmbher, about twenty miles west of Jayanagar.
E.
रुम the district of Ruma or Sāmbher, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also रौम, and रौमलवण.

n. (-णं)
Sāmbher salt; see the last.
E.
रौम as above, and लवण salt.
